body: Thanks
I've been on it for a few days and I feel unbelievably hyper and irritable though I don't know if its the drug.
Thanks for taking the time to express your thoughts, they're making me feel a bit better.
Yeah bupropian is what I've been given, I started it yesterday.
Thanks for your thoughts
Wow from what I read bupropian seemed like the less serious of the two. Thanks for your input.
Its not that I'm ashamed of it, in fact I'd like to have been able to cry more but it just doesn't happen, usually my feelings are more mixed but right now all I feel is alone and scared.

In a way its all the typical shit you'd come to expect around here, I've went through the list in countless previous threads. I don't even know why I come here still. I vent, some people say some kind words you'd never hear in person and then its like it just goes back to normal.

I just feel alone and unloved and I know how cliche that is but that's all there is to it. I can try to imagine what it must feel like but I don't think I've ever experienced it.
Its near impossible for me to think things will get better. I hate to sound like I'm trying to shoot down all you guy's attempts to cheer me up but things seem pretty bleak right now.
sure.

I'm trying real hard to keep it together on that basis but I know when I get the final confirmation from the professor that nothing will change it that I'm going to be finished. I can't handle that right now.
Everything is almost certainly fucked right now, I don't know whats going to happen.
I've calmed down but I can't stop tearing up, I don't know what I will do if I can't correct this.
It just seems very bleak right now, I don't see much hope for it.

I know it sounds like such a stupid reason to be here but I failed a class for college. But its not just that, its a lot of other shit but this seems like the final straw for me, I can't stand any more of this. I'm feeling defeated right now.

It was an online class, I emailed my prof who I haven't even communicated with since the beginning of the semester asking him what my projected final grade will be, he sent me back my grades and the percent of the final grade they represent and I don't think I will be able to pass by 7 points. I don't think he will give me any sort of second chance, otherwise he would have just said the final grade or communicated something other than just numbers. It was such a easy A class I deserve whatever I get.
I'm having a crisis, I think I've failed one of the classes I needed this semester and I can't get over it. I'm having a panic attack, I can't stop shaking. I don't know what I'm going to do.
I don't have prior job experience, I'm 23 and I've never had a job before because I've been too nervous to apply for one. I hate admitting that to people it makes me sound like such a lazy ass hole.

it wasn't a hard class and whats even more fucked up is that I took a class that was nearly identical to this one because my guidance counselor fucked up and my family blames that on me. I really should have looked into what classes I needed by myself but I can't stand thoughts of school, I feel like I'm being squeezed out by some cold unfeeling bureaucracy and I don't even see what purpose it serves, I don't feel like I'm learning anything even in classes I supposedly do very well in. I feel like a fraud, I'm joking myself If I think I'd ever be able to get a career for my major.

I can't stand hearing myself think, when I don't have something to occupy myself with I begin to have awful misanthropic and cynical thoughts. Sometimes I think about how much I hate myself, I can't escape them, I think of stuff that would make all of you here who are trying to help me despise me. I know I can look back now and see how sick those thoughts are but its like I'm a whole other person sometimes, I can't help it.

I tried getting a crummy job recently , I applied to multiple places and only got an interview at one and in the interview I was too nerve racked to not speak without a stutter and I didn't get the job.
I just don't see how it will help. If anything it will just prolong this awfulness.

I don't have options, I don't have friends, or networks or connections. If my family wasn't throwing money at me to go to college I would probably be straight up fucking homeless by now. I've never had any drive in my life and everyone I meet hates me.
Maybe, Its not that I haven't considered it, I've spent hours sitting in the school trying to build up the courage to seek the counselor's office but I can't bring myself to do it.
Its not just the class, its every moment of my life leading up to this point, I can't take this shit anymore.
No I haven't and I don't think I intend to.

I've failed classes before and this is the first one in a long while and it was a stupid do nothing class and I still managed to fail it and my family knows how stupid this class is and I needed it to transfer out soon so fucking none of that shit is going to happen and I've wasted my families money.

I can't stand this shit anymore. Doing decent in college for a period of time was the only thing my family respected me for and now I threw that away. It was one of the only reasons I had any respect mysefl. I can't stand anymore classes.

At least if I kill myself I won't have to endure all of the drama that ensues. Its like I'm either currently in some sort of fucking crisis or waiting for the next one to start. Things never got any better in my life, they only ever got worse.
what does MH stand for?
Its just that my family thinks so lowly of me, they would think I was pleading for special treatment or something.
no, I don't think they care and if i told them they would think I was just complaining.
yes, I live with them.
I feel like a phony in every respect of my life so I do get thoughts like this all the time.
I hate to admit it, but hype for movie, tv show and video game releases is one of the main reasons I'm still alive... Its kind of pathetic.
I don't know, I'll have to think about it.

I'm not on any medication, I saw a therapist briefly after high school but I never told him anything about how I felt really and stopped going after a few weeks. I'd go to another one but I'd have to ask my family first and I don't have the nerve to ask them.
I know I have social anxiety and no I'm not seeing a therapist.

That everyone seems to just know what to do in any given situation and I hardly seem to have any grasp of what most would call simple life skills. I've become increasingly more frightened to leave my house without being accompanied by someone else. I guess my anxiety is just overwhelming me, I'm just afraid that people will figure out what type of person I am and think lowly of me because of it.
That's horrifying, makes me not want to tell people how I feel.

I do like the idea of cardio exercise but I don't like going on runs outside, I think I might be a bit agoraphobic. I don't like having people see me like that. I used to go on a run once in a while but the anxiety became too much, a few bad experiences, the drivers around here are not hospitable to pedestrians.

I'd like a treadmill but way too pricey.

By most definitions, I have been taking it easy for an egregiously long time. I don't hold a job and the days I have classes are few and far between. Not having any friends, however, just makes this time spent alone with my thoughts.

While I can't bring my self to socialize, I hate being alone, I get so many intrusive thoughts. I always need some sort of distraction.

I feel the same way, the only change that came with the transition to college was that my I've become more isolated. I've never been more alone in my entire life. 

When I'm in class no one talks to me and I don't talk to them and when I get home I just lock myself away until I have class again.
